rect.title: U1: Daisy Seed 3 / Seed2 DFM compatibility review
rect.desc: Common 40-pin footprint candidate; onboard audio and 12-bit DAC unused. Check USB-C and DFM mechanical envelope.

rect.title: U2: AD7606C-18 candidate
rect.desc: SOFTWARE mode OS[2:0]=111; select one DOUTA, bipolar ranges, bandwidth per channel. No audio HPF. Register/DMA driver missing.

rect.title: U3: DAC8568B (gain 1, midscale reset) candidate
rect.desc: B grade matters: internal 2.5 V reference, output span 2.5 V, midscale reset; enable reference in software. 16-bit output, not a 24-bit codec.

rect.title: U4: MCP23017-E/SO candidate
rect.desc: I2C 0x20. Encoders A/B stay on MCU GPIO; only clicks/keys and static output requests use expander.

rect.title: U7: ADG5412FBRUZ candidate
rect.desc: Not ADG5413F. IN=0 disconnects. Protected S faces jack; driver on D. Fault/power-off isolation needs bench qualification; not protection against every output collision.

rect.title: U8: ADG5412FBRUZ candidate
rect.desc: Not ADG5413F. IN=0 disconnects. Protected S faces jack; driver on D. Fault/power-off isolation needs bench qualification; not protection against every output collision.

rect.title: U9: OPA4197ID candidate
rect.desc: Candidate: verify offset, stability, noise, output protection and matched ratios. 4*Vdac - 4*Vref gives approximately +/-5 V.

rect.title: U10: OPA4197ID candidate
rect.desc: Candidate: verify offset, stability, noise, output protection and matched ratios. 4*Vdac - 4*Vref gives approximately +/-5 V.

rect.title: U11: OPA4197ID candidate
rect.desc: Candidate: verify offset, stability, noise, output protection and matched ratios. 4*Vdac - 4*Vref gives approximately +/-5 V.

rect.title: U12: SN74AHCT125 candidate
rect.desc: 5 V powered TTL-input buffers; validate timing/skew at selected SPI clock. Not LVC125 at 5 V.

rect.title: U13: SN74AHCT125 candidate
rect.desc: 5 V powered TTL-input buffers; validate timing/skew at selected SPI clock. Not LVC125 at 5 V.
